record.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with Amendment procedure?
record.explanation: Answer D: Article 368. Article 368 governs the amendment procedure for the Constitution. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
